source: Expected outputs produced by Node.js (JSON.stringify for primitives, UTF-16 code-unit key sort), which RFC 8785 adopts. The first 24 numbers are RFC 8785 Appendix B inputs; structures 1 and 2 are the RFC 8785 section 3.2.2/3.2.3 examples. 'rejected' inputs parse as JSON but must raise ValueError: integers outside the I-JSON safe range and lone surrogates.
